{{CharInfobox |color={{green color}} |corecolor={{green color light}} |bordercolor={{green color dark}} |name=Tommy |jname=トミー |tmname=Tommy |slogan=no |image=Tommy TW.png |size=100px |caption=Tommy |colors=yes |eyes=Green |hair=Brown |gender=Male |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Galar]] |gameanim=yes |pv=yes |pvnum=TW01 |pvname=Letter |envagame=Morgan Berry |javagame=[[Kei Shindō]] }} '''Tommy''' (Japanese: '''トミー''' ''Tommy'') is a character who appeared in [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]]. ==History== [[File:Tommy Twilight Wings.png|thumb|left|250px|Tommy in John's room]] Tommy was being treated in the same hospital as {{gal|John}}, where the two shared a wardroom. They became friends during their stay, bonding over their shared dreams of becoming [[Pokémon Trainer]]s like their idol, [[Galar]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Leon]]. In ''[[TW01|Letter]]'', John wrote a letter to Leon and planned to deliver it to [[Rose]] during his hospital visit. However, when John missed the visit, Tommy helped him deliver the letter to Chairman Rose in person. In ''[[TW06|Moonlight]]'', Tommy had been discharged after making a full recovery. However, before he was discharged, he had an argument with John, who he believed was not being realistic and was too focused on becoming a Trainer. To make amends, Tommy sought out [[Allister]] in the hopes of getting a ticket to Leon's next match. Allister declined the request, but after learning about Tommy and John's argument, he helped Tommy reach the hospital and apologize to John in person. John accepted Tommy's apology, and the two agreed to become the greatest Trainers together. In ''[[TW07|Sky]]'', Tommy watched the match between Leon and [[Raihan]] at [[Wyndon Stadium]] together with Allister. ==Character== More knowledgeable about the world at large, Tommy acts like an older brother to John, talking to him enthusiastically about Pokémon. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{green color}}|bordercolor={{green color dark}} |ja=真堂圭 ''[[Kei Shindō]]'' |en=Morgan Berry |ko=곽규미 ''Kwak Gyu-mi''}} ==Trivia== [[File:John Tommy first day.png|thumb|250px|John and Tommy as Trainers]] * In his [https://web.archive.org/web/20200115193820/https://www.pokemon.co.jp/ex/hakumei_no_tsubasa/t/images/character-body1.png artwork on the Japanese site], Tommy's eyes were initially colored brown rather than green. * As a tribute to the end of the miniseries, director Shingo Yamashita [https://twitter.com/yama_ic/status/1291362136082415622 posted] an image of the first day of John and Tommy's {{pkmn|journey}} on his Twitter. In the image, Tommy is seen with a {{p|Dreepy}} and John with a {{p|Rookidee}}.
